prCreate.body:
Caller-side H payload Copy passed through an ordinary `u8 -> u8` helper already passes CHECK and authentic owned proof, but its later same-original-T Copy was refused by the direct C17 consumer. This connects that exact direct-H2 lane to the existing readonly-u8 validator and runtime-value emission before the existing unit terminal receiver.

The production logic is the preserved P1539 local a026 candidate, unchanged in both files. Ten ordinary CTests now cover the two frozen complete sources, genuine public actual/formal/result-to-T evidence, four authority/loan negatives, artifact refusal and pristine retry, two rollback sites, and CLI/CHECK/API-byte agreement plus strict C17/native zero/nonzero H0/H1/H2. Native observation reuses existing passive hooks and physical malloc/free wrappers.

Refs #1539, C1243/C1244. **DRAFT HOLD; READY/merge belongs to Coordination.**

- Base/sole parent: `9c9b17f7f0584c88a92ab284f57e4a93b8ab350b` (Draft17.38).
- Fixed production blobs: `1d17ce025905b18b0b92dbae81ffb8f3d27f947f`, `10fe0ac4d98a55f261a34c9ad1508a7f5d2e4b8b`; byte-identical to local `a026544d52ce631e339dbd5ec40c6fc3ebcca734`. No production reformat was needed.
- No source-law, issuer, public API/ABI, owner, T/toolchain, workflow, hook or Required changes. Ordinary scalar helper receives no H/ref/ptr/Domain/owner; terminal receiver stays unit with no payload use.
- Scope is the selected bounded direct composition; no general scalar helper, arbitrary payload API or ordinary-safe facade claim.

Validation before publication: one fresh GCC14.2.0 Release/FORTIFY2 frontend build (35 C translation units), one public-probe target; all ten registered tests pass. The registered native driver ran six H0/H1/H2 guests with exact CLI/API C17 bytes, physical second-H callee/first-H caller cleanup, same original T old/current/sibling, and real zero. Two existing host sites ran fault+retry four cases with no-clobber/rollback. Pinned formatting passes. Additional local charge99/100 selected; frontend1/2, probe1/2, guest6/12, host2sites4/8. Local full CTest/LLVM/SDK acquisition not run.

Natural same-head validation must establish FULL1201 ×5, PARTIAL1200 ×1, EARLY84 ×2. EARLY executes zero new P1539 tests and is not their merge evidence. At most one further HEAD is reserved for a concrete in-scope registration/apparatus/format defect; no manual retry/dispatch/cancel/force.

Original complete FIRST, probe and C17 RED, local100/18 executions and Evidence0355 remain immutable: [local FINAL](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1539#issuecomment-7002505195), [original Evidence](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Evidence/tree/archive/p1539-c1240-local-20261119). New integration/CI custody and all eight original outcomes will be reported separately.

VALUE-ALIGNMENT-RISK: the identity helper is trivial. Finite technical composition and normal test delivery do not establish protected safe API/all-safe-reachable-state coverage or reduced author-plus-ordinary-safe-caller UB audit dependency closure. Product GO remains PAUSED/H1 HOLD/comparative value UNMEASURED.
